# Behind the curtain of commercial arbitration: Christopher Bogart and Jacomijn van Haersolte-van Hof in conversation


- International arbitration


June 11, 2026


**Jeffery Commission & Christiane Deniger**


## Summary


Commercial arbitration often turns on factors that operate beyond the formal procedural framework. Drawing on insights from Burford CEO Christopher Bogart and former LCIA Director General Jacomijn van Haersolte-van Hof, this discussion explores tribunal selection, institutional oversight, procedural efficiency and the evolving role of legal finance in complex cross-border disputes.
